rationale: Both independently found the same core bug (engine forces rel_l1_thresh=0.2, making the model-specific 0.17 default dead code), citing nearly identical files/lines, so precision is high for both. Y goes substantially further: it also surfaces the E2E-smoke-doesn't-verify-a-cache-hit gap that the human reviewer explicitly flagged in their validation notes, plus several additional well-grounded findings (memory retention scaling, eager RoPE computation, a stale-t_emb blind spot in the new cache-hit test, and a drive-by frame-count change bleeding into the unrelated FP8 test) all tied to specific, verifiable file/line evidence. X is accurate but stops after its single finding, leaving recall noticeably lower.
